subject: Conditional ingest & testcase fencing — acceptance runbook
messages:
From: Sarah Gomez <sarah@brightcart.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Devon Priest <devon.priest@beacon.ai>
Date: 2026-11-01T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: MAP & dataset exchange for BRG-8721 — initial intake

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. BrightCart is ready to move forward with a short evaluation: a ~20k prompt/testcase pack and a scoped probe corpus to run for 3 weeks. Procurement asked me to surface a brief mutual action plan so we can align on acceptance gates, retention, and restrictive use controls before we ship samples.

Quick list of what we need from Redwood:
- A short acceptance runbook (steps for ingest, sandbox credentials, and how pass/fail is measured).
- Confirmation of ephemeral access windows (max TTL per key/session).
- Data handling: who has access to raw probe files and how retention/destruction will be enforced.
- Any required export controls / embargo language for the testcases.

Attachments: brightcart-probe-manifest.csv (sample file list)

Procurement contact: procurement@acmeretail.com (cc'd separately). If you can send a one-page runbook and a proposed signature-ready MPA, we can start procurement review this week.

Best,
Sarah
Sarah Gomez
Head of ML Programs, BrightCart
Attachment: brightcart-probe-manifest.csv (CSV, 1.2KB)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Gomez <sarah@brightcart.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: MAP & dataset exchange for BRG-8721 — initial intake

Sarah — thanks, and glad the demo landed. High-level response and proposed next steps below; I attached a concise acceptance runbook and a draft MPA for signature.

Proposed acceptance runbook (summary):
1) Ingest: BrightCart uploads probe manifest + sample bundle to our ingest bucket (read-only until acceptance).
2) Sandbox creds: We provision a time-limited API key scoped to the BrightCart sandbox project (default TTL 14 days; renewal permitted twice, each for 7 days).
3) Validation: Run the supplied 20k prompt set; pass criteria = no more than X% hallucination on the two seeded QA cases and latency under 350ms P50 for the probe traffic profile.
4) Artifacts & logs: We will provide token-level cost and per-route latency logs for the evaluation window; raw probe files remain in the BrightCart bucket until signed MPA is in place.
5) Takedown & destruction: After acceptance or expiry, we will instruct BrightCart to remove the sample bundle; Redwood will revoke keys and purge cached copies from ephemeral KV caches within 48 hours.

Risk controls we propose: fenced project, RBAC for access, ephemeral keys, and an audit snapshot retained for 90 days to support troubleshooting (not accessible to product teams without escalation).

Attachments: acceptance-runbook-BRG-8721.pdf (1 page), draft-mpa-BRG-8721.docx (signature-ready).

If that aligns, I’ll circulate the DocuSign link for the MPA and loop our security lead (Kimberly) to sign off on the audit/retention bits. Proposed close timeline: procurement signature in 7 business days, test window to follow within 48 hours of signed MPA.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Account Lead, Redwood Inference
Attachment: acceptance-runbook-BRG-8721.pdf (PDF, 0.9KB); draft-mpa-BRG-8721.docx (DOCX, 12KB)
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Sarah Gomez <sarah@brightcart.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T08:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: MAP & dataset exchange for BRG-8721 — gating details

Looping in a few operational details from the runtime/serving side so the acceptance criteria are actionable:

- Sandbox provisioning: we will create a dedicated tenant id and apply prefix/KV caching scoped to that tenant only. No cross-tenant caching.
- Key TTL: default 14 days; renewals require an explicit email from the BrightCart admin (we will not auto-extend).
- Batching profile: tell us expected max sequence length and qps profile; if peak qps > 1500 we will discuss a short dedicated burst pool (costs separate).
- Data residency: test traffic will run in our us-west-2 region unless BrightCart requires eu; confirm.

Also: operationally we recommend a short acceptance smoke test (5 seed prompts) the morning after ingestion to validate routing and KV warmup. If the smoke test fails, we will log defects and schedule a retest window within 24 hours.

--Priyom
Priyom Das
Product Operations, Redwood Inference
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Gomez <sarah@brightcart.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-03T10:18:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: MAP & dataset exchange for BRG-8721 — compliance / SOC2 note

Forwarding the thread to call out two compliance items we need to lock before DocuSign: 

1) Audit snapshot retention: we can keep token-level logs for 90 days (redwood policy) but procurement asked if BrightCart requires longer; if so we need a JIRA to capture the request and a potential add-on.
2) Embargo & IP: our standard MPA includes restricted use for testcases (no productization, no redistribution). BrightCart, please confirm if you need an NDA amendment or additional embargo terms.

Sarah — if BrightCart is fine with the 90-day forensic window and the standard restricted-use clause, we can sign and proceed. If you need an exception (e.g., 12 months), we’ll need leadership approval and will route through legal — that will add ~5 business days.

Kimberly Park
Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Gomez <sarah@brightcart.com>, procurement@acmeretail.com
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-04T16:45:00-08:00
Subject: Final runbook, signature link, and closing cadence (BRG-8721)

Sarah / Acme procurement — thanks for the quick turnaround. Per the thread above and today's internal signoffs, attaching the final one-page acceptance runbook and the MPA for signature. Key items to confirm before signing:

- Acceptance window: 3 weeks test window starting within 48 hours of signed MPA.
- Key TTL & renewals: default 14 days, two renewals (7d each) allowed on written request.
- Audit retention: 90 days (no extra retention unless requested by procurement; see change control).
- Usage constraints: testcases and promptpacks are provided for evaluation only — no reproduction, redistribution, or training on product models.

Next steps:
1) Please review and sign via DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/BRG-8721
2) Procurement to confirm billing contact; we will need a PO or billing email to finalize provisioning.
3) Once signed, we will provision the sandbox and send ingest instructions within 24 hours.

Attachments: signed-mpa-BRG-8721.pdf (placeholder pending signature), testcase-sample-README.md (usage guidance).

If anything is unclear, call my cell. Otherwise, if we have signature by EOD next Thursday (2026-11-11), target test window the following Monday.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Account Lead, Redwood Inference
Attachment: signed-mpa-BRG-8721.pdf (PDF, stub); testcase-sample-README.md (MD, 2.3KB)
